column8: ∀ {ε : Type} {a b : Except ε Unit}, (do a b) = Except.ok () → a = Except.ok ()

∀ {config : Minidregg.Kernel.NativeHost.Config} {opened : Minidregg.Kernel.NativeHost.Opened config} (derived : Minidregg.Kernel.NativeHostReplay.Derived config opened) (judged : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableReceiverIO.Judged derived.transport opened.durable derived.intent), (∃ kernel height turn sealing posts extra, Minidregg.Kernel.ActivitySeatEnd.finish kernel opened.durable.snapshot height turn = Except.ok (posts, extra) ∧ derived.intent = Minidregg.Kernel.ActivitySeatEnd.AdmittedTurn.finalIntent sealing posts extra turn) ∨ (∃ posts, derived.intent.writes = List.map (Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityWire.Post.write Minidregg.Compiler.ResourceBirthCodec.rootBytes) posts ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.SeatStore.Inert opened.durable.snapshot posts) ∨ Minidregg.Kernel.ObjectiveActivityGate.ordinaryGate derived.intent = Except.ok ()

∀ {rootBytes : List UInt8 → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Digest} (transport : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableReceiverIO.Transport) (loaded : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableReceiverIO.Loaded rootBytes) (intent : Minidregg.Kernel.DurableDataIntent.DataIntent rootBytes) (judged : Minidregg.Compiler.DurableReceiverIO.Judged transport loaded intent), transport.sourceGate loaded.snapshot intent = Except.ok ()
